key_lessons_for_framework: CA universe survived COVID better than industry: 0 in-universe defaults vs 14 nationwide CCRC bankruptcies since March 2020. Pacific region IL held up best (90.9% vs national 85.7% at Q4 2021).

Cal-Mortgage insurance is a structural backstop that obscures underlying obligor stress — Atherton (BB) and Sequoia/Viamonte (new build) BOTH experienced stress but bondholders protected. Framework should NOT credit Cal-Mortgage as 'safe' for honesty-alpha purposes — the underlying obligor stress was real.

The biggest CA CCRC stress event in window was CNMH Ch 11 (March 2021) — but CNMH was OUTSIDE our 2025 universe because it was sold/converted to rental. Our universe DOES NOT include the actual stressed CA name. Backtest is biased toward survivors.

Front Porch + Covia merger 2020-2022 = friendly affiliation that was credit-positive (A absorbs A-). Framework's MA leverage flag should distinguish hostile/financial-distress mergers from friendly affiliations.

FY2019 specific metrics (DCOH, IL/AL/SNF occupancy) for most obligors are not publicly extractable without direct CDSS KIR access — PDF binary obfuscation. To fully validate framework on 2019-2022 window, would need to procure KIRs directly.
ECS (RCFE-only, no SNF) is the cleanest model for how to survive COVID — no SNF revenue collapse exposure. HumanGood and Front Porch were SNF-exposed but diversified enough to absorb it.
honesty_alpha_implications: Framework's value: Would have correctly identified Atherton (BB rated, high SNF, single-site Alhambra) as the weakest CA CCRC at 2019 snapshot. The fact that no default occurred owes to (a) Cal-Mortgage backstop, (b) PPP federal aid, (c) demographic resilience of CA — NOT to operator strength.

Survivorship bias warning: Our universe excludes CNMH (CA's actual COVID-era CCRC default). To honestly backtest, we should re-collect with 2019-12-31 universe definition that INCLUDES all CA CCRCs with outstanding muni bonds at that date — not the surviving 2025 set.

Conclusion: COVID-stress test is INSUFFICIENT to validate or invalidate the framework on this universe. Real stress events were either (a) absent from current universe (CNMH), (b) backstopped by insurance (Cal-Mortgage names), or (c) unverifiable due to KIR access. The framework's 2019 signal would correctly highlight Atherton + Sequoia/Viamonte — both experienced stress, but framework cannot claim credit for predicting outcomes that didn't materialize publicly.

Next step: Either (i) expand backtest universe to include all CA CCRCs at 2019-12-31 (incl. CNMH) and re-run framework, OR (ii) accept that CA CCRC universe at 2019 was structurally too healthy / too insured to provide meaningful event density for backtesting.
